title: Gate Envelope
description: Machine-parseable verdict emitted by L3 quality gate agents (code-reviewer, security-reviewer, tdd-guide, e2e-runner, merge gate). Consumed by the L1 orchestrator to drive the escalation ladder and circuit breaker. See docs/E1_GATE_ENVELOPE.md for design rationale.

schema_version.description: SemVer of this envelope schema. Bumped on breaking shape changes. Orchestrator MUST refuse envelopes from unknown major versions.

gate_name.description: Identifier of the gate that produced this envelope. Used by the orchestrator to know which gate failed and what to retry/escalate.

verdict.description: Top-level pass/fail signal. WARN means findings exist but none block — orchestrator may proceed but should surface to human.

failure_class.description:
ONLY meaningful when verdict=FAIL. Determines whether the orchestrator escalates to a higher-tier worker or halts to a human checkpoint. Set to 'none' when verdict is PASS or WARN.

- worker_quality: the worker produced a buggy/incomplete output the gate could prove wrong. ESCALATE Haiku→Sonnet→Opus→human.
- task_underspecified: gate cannot tell pass from fail because the goal or acceptance criteria are ambiguous. HALT to human; do not escalate.
- blocked: an external dependency (missing migration, missing secret, network, broken fixture) prevents the work. HALT to human.
- out_of_scope: the work proposed by the worker reaches outside the slot scope (touches files not in the slot's allowlist, modifies foundational config, etc.). HALT to human.
- none: only valid when verdict is PASS or WARN.

confidence.description: Gate's self-reported confidence in its own verdict, 0.0–1.0. Below 0.6 means the orchestrator should treat verdict as advisory and surface to human. Optional but recommended.

findings.description: Structured findings. May be empty even when verdict is FAIL (e.g. failure_class=blocked has no per-file findings).

summary.description: One-sentence human-readable summary of the verdict. Surfaced in dashboards and dev-log digests.

model_used.description: Model identifier that produced this envelope. Used by the orchestrator to enforce the gate-agent paradox rule (gates must run at Sonnet+).

tier.description: Convenience tier label corresponding to model_used.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp at which the gate emitted this envelope.

scope.description: Optional scope context — useful for the merge gate and for circuit-breaker accounting.

cost.description: Optional gate-cost telemetry. Feeds the circuit breaker's per-iteration token budget (gates are per-iteration cost, not fixed overhead — see E1_GATE_ENVELOPE.md §3).

severity.description: CRITICAL blocks; HIGH should block unless skip-reason; MEDIUM/LOW are advisory.

rule.description: Short rule identifier (e.g. 'sql-injection', 'mutable-default', 'rls-bypass'). Stable across runs — used for deduplication and trend analysis.

file.description: Relative path from project root. Omit when finding is not file-local.

line.description: 1-indexed line number. Omit when not applicable.

suggestion.description: Concrete remediation. Omit when the rule is descriptive only.
